text.content:
Scene: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.scenes.Scene.1woE8vDxl14ltD9K]{20. The Burning Giant}

Actors: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.V9BYDTHtwTLr4Zyi]{Kaldurok}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.6IiUReIrCb7lJVLa]{Elder Maren}

Zone Zone 19: Branthlend Mountains, burning toward the Glenebon Uplands (a scorched valley with a dying village)
Hex 2.4 on the Stolen Lands map
Type Combat with a kingdom-threat clock
Threat Beyond Extreme at party level 16; hold this site. Base lerritan: Severe 120 at party level 18, Moderate 80 at party level 19. Elite lerritan (L22): Severe 120 at party level 19.
Creatures Lerritan (L21, Bestiary 2); use the elite adjustment at party level 19

Irovetti's map note. A line of hexes coloured in with red crayon, running from the Branthlends toward the lowlands, with the note: "toward us — or toward them?" and an arrow pointing away from Pitax that has been scratched out and redrawn twice.

Background. A lerritan named Kaldurok woke under the Branthlends and has followed a seam of obsidian down the valleys, burning everything it passes. It honours Ymeri, the evil elemental demigod of fire, and wants to set a great fire in her name. Irovetti's scouts tracked its path and found it heading toward the Glenebon. Each week it advances one hex. Unless stopped, it reaches one of the PCs' settlements within the season. Its current target is a herding village, Kettle Hollow, which lies directly in its path.

Arrival.

The air shimmers with heat long before you see it. Black smoke climbs over the ridge, and then a giant the height of a watchtower steps into view, its skin glassy black, lava welling in the cracks of its chest. A small volcano on its back belches cinders. Below it, the roofs of a village smoke and crackle. "Run," the giant laughs, "or burn. Ymeri welcomes both."

Features.

  • The burning village. Kettle Hollow has 12 buildings. Each round the lerritan stays within 60 feet of the village, one building collapses (DC 38 Reflex for anyone inside, 8d6 fire and bludgeoning).
  • Villagers. Thirty villagers, led by their headwoman Elder Maren, hide in a grain cellar and a well-house. Each round, a PC can Interact to lead up to 5 villagers to safety (the stream to the south is safe).
  • The stream. A cold stream crosses the valley. The lerritan avoids water. Creatures in the stream gain fire resistance 10.
  • Obsidian scree. Shards from the lerritan's skin make the ground around it difficult terrain within 20 feet.

Running the encounter. Run a 3-round evacuation clock alongside the fight. Villagers left at the end of round 3 take damage when the lerritan's Volcanic Eruption hits the village. The lerritan opens with Volcanic Eruption, then uses Tenacious Flames to stop the PCs recovering from persistent fire damage. It strikes with its warhammer and uses Throw Rock against anyone who flees to the stream. It fights to the death; it believes Ymeri will reforge it.

Outcomes.

  • Lerritan slain, village saved. Kettle Hollow survives. The PCs' kingdom gains 1 Fame and the villagers offer the PCs a home if they need one.
  • Lerritan slain, village lost. The PCs end the threat. The kingdom suffers 1 Unrest from refugees.
  • PCs retreat. The lerritan continues. One week later it reaches a PC settlement; run a Disaster kingdom event and reroll the encounter there.

Rewards. 120 XP at party level 18 (base) or 19 (elite). Treasure: the lerritan's obsidian warhammer counts as a level 18 +3 greater striking flaming warhammer sized Gargantuan. Its glass skin yields 6,000 gp in volcanic glass, usable as a crafting reagent. The village elders give the PCs 500 gp in thanks.

Scaling. At party level 19, use the elite lerritan and add two fire elementals summoned by Volcanic Eruption. For a smaller party, give the villagers one more round to evacuate.
